method.timing: Shared PowerForge runner, 2 warmups and 7 samples, Rotated order, no outlier removal, Normal priority, standard cohort; raw latency statistics matched the canonical summary.
method.order: Before A then B; private candidate after B then A. One pair per domain, with no pooling across domains.
method.limits: Fresh public Load.Read(Structured) under default parser limits, 1000 maximum pages, 10 million page/document work units, CancellationToken.None. 500 pages is the measured scale, not the maximum supported scale.
method.validation: Every page has exactly one header, no footer and one ordered body marker. Full ordered semantic classification and source/input/tool hashes reconcile. Poppler independently validates source text and page geometry; it is not an independent semantic classifier.
method.qualification: Shared-host diagnostics; retain all losses and outliers. p95 from seven observations is not production tail latency. Process-wide managed allocation is not retained or peak memory. API-enforced work-budget tests are separate correctness proof.
method.source: Candidate is exact f4490e8571 plus the captured 28-line semantic envelope fast path; the test file is untracked and is not part of the benchmark binary. The baseline binary has b5d427 informational identity and already compiled the evidence extension; exact binary and source identities are distinct and recorded.

source.qualification: Private measured candidate is f4490e8571 plus exact uncommitted28line semantic-envelope fastpath and7untracked testcases; no other product differences. Unit tests are not compiled by benchmark project. Exact patch/source/binary hashes preserve dirtycandidate provenance. Baseline product source is equivalentf449, compiled withb5d427informational identity beforeevidenceextensioncommit.

provenance.benchmark.StructuredContract: Fresh Load(byte[], default parser limits).Read(Structured, default built-in work budgets, CancellationToken.None). provenance.benchmark.DestinationContract: Both lanes compose the identical embedded Carlito business corpus with PDF 1.7, compressed streams and ForwardOnly object serialization. DestinationDirect saves to FileStream; DestinationCopied saves to MemoryStream, calls ToArray and File.WriteAllBytes. Both close a complete file inside measurement. No forced durable flush; OS cache/storage effects are part of the result. Complete forward layout is retained by both. CancellationToken.None is passed to Save; no cancellation latency is measured.

Digests are integrity proof, not independent producer proof.

method.comparison: Current strategy comparison, not a before/after change: identical PDF 1.7 ForwardOnly business corpus, composition plus Save(FileStream) versus composition plus Save(MemoryStream), ToArray and File.WriteAllBytes. Complete file closure is inside the operation; cached writes with no durable flush.
method.cohorts: Standard 1/20/100 pages, 2 warmups and 7 samples; separately sampled 100/500 pages, 2 warmups and 3 samples, 5 ms. Do not compare instrumented memory latency directly to the standard cohort.
method.validation: Every persisted PDF digest is checked against the identical prepared reference; all pages are independently read by Poppler; complete writer reports are equal across strategies. FinalByteArrayMaterialized differs intentionally; the forward writer's FinalArtifactBuffered remains false for both.
method.memory: Both retain full layout; periodic process managed-heap and working-set observations may miss peaks and include unrelated activity. These are not retained-heap, precise peak-memory or constant-space claims. Writer payload-store metrics have separate meaning.
method.qualification: Shared-host diagnostic evidence; all raw samples, outliers and losses are retained; one pass per domain, short samples and no portable ranking.

provenance.benchmark.Measurement: PowerForge owns elapsed timing, process-wide managed allocation, placement, rotation and raw samples; outliers are retained. Source/reference preparation, readback, artifact qualification and export are outside measurement. Sampled memory is a separate cohort.
provenance.benchmark.StructuredContract: Fresh Load(byte[], default parser limits).Read(Structured, default built-in work budgets, CancellationToken.None). Every 600 x 800 point page has Running operations at x=36+.02*p, top=36, font=10+.001*p; Body markerD4 at x=36, top=240, font=12. p is one-based. Validate exactly one header per page and the complete body sequence.
provenance.benchmark.DestinationContract: Both lanes compose the identical embedded Carlito business corpus with PDF 1.7, compressed streams and ForwardOnly object serialization. DestinationDirect saves to FileStream; DestinationCopied saves to MemoryStream, calls ToArray and File.WriteAllBytes. Both close a complete file inside measurement. No forced durable flush; OS cache/storage effects are part of the result. Complete forward layout is retained by both. CancellationToken.None is passed to Save; no cancellation latency is measured.
provenance.benchmark.ValidationContract: Poppler independently qualifies every prepared PDF page. Structured read validates logical header classification and exact ordered body content. Every destination is read after measurement, checked against an exact prepared forward-PDF digest, qualified by managed page/text/writer assertions and independently extracted through Poppler. Digests are integrity proof, not independent producer proof.
